scene: Wind whips your beanie as the motorized sidecar buzzes along rooftops.
beats: You dial past static until singing toasters harmonize through the speaker. The sidecar skids outside Midnight Radio Repair, and the door pops open.
Unbuckling the pouch reveals glowing vacuum tubes cushioned in velvet. The driver brakes firmly outside Midnight Radio Repair as the sidecar door swings wide.
You tap the driver's shoulder, and they nod toward flickering neon signs. The motor purrs to a stop at Midnight Radio Repair, its door unlatching.
picture: Flat side view. Inside the motorized rig, the dashboard radio sits on the left, the player in burnt-orange corduroy sits centre with a canvas pouch between his knees, and the helmeted driver steers on the right. Rooftop rainbow sprinklers and cloud tanks whiz past in a low strip behind.
shown: a tiny buzzing dashboard radio on the left with a red tuning knob
a bulging leather tool pouch resting centre between your knees
the leather-jacketed driver on the right gripping vibrating chrome handlebars
